purpose: Pass-B ceiling projection for the 4TU re-evaluation pre-registration (target proposal only, not a result)
author: gpr-processing-expert
inputs: 4TU ground truth: number of exclude_x items per activity only (no depth value used or printed)

model.qc_retention: independent Bernoulli thinning with the review-sample rates (m29c_track_diagnosis.md 12-5, v1.9): main B+D+E auto 28/130, manual 21/39; bd B+D auto 91/130, manual 35/39; noqc 1
model.clustering: eval_depth_4tu.cluster_depths complete linkage, width 0.10 m, support filter >= 2 lines (eval_depth_4tu.supported)
model.ceiling: sum over gt activities of min(n_est, n_gt) / 388

assumptions: QC retention independent per candidate (real retention is correlated within a pipe and site)
apex re-selection within +-0.5 period ignored (depth proxy from candidate tau)
review-sample rates applied to the whole population without site weighting
